entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
Heard Sri Ram Mohan, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Ratan Singh, learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 19.10.2022, registered as Case Crime No. 0234 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act and 3/4 Muslim Mahila Marriage Act, 2019, Police Station .Mahila Thana, District Saharanpur.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioners in the aforesaid case.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
